neighbours.label: best guess for a positional, mostly gate-closed pole: the comma closing a short sentence-initial linking phrase ('For this reason,', 'In fact,') early in a passage
fire: The harvest was poor again this year. For that reason, the cooperative raised its prices.
The bridge has been closed since May. As a consequence, buses now take the long way round.
Nobody expected the team to win. In fact, most fans had already left the stadium.
The first trial gave unclear results. For this reason, a second trial was planned.
The museum lost its main sponsor. In addition, visitor numbers fell by a third.
The recipe looks complicated. In practice, it takes about twenty minutes.
Rents doubled within five years. As a result, many families moved away.
The old ferry was sold in March. In its place, the town bought two small boats.
quiet: The harvest was poor again this year and the cooperative raised its prices.
The bridge has been closed since May and buses now take the long way round.
Nobody expected the team to win and most fans had already left the stadium.
The first trial gave unclear results and a second trial was planned.
The museum lost its main sponsor and visitor numbers fell by a third.
The recipe looks complicated but it takes about twenty minutes.
Rents doubled within five years and many families moved away.
The old ferry was sold in March and the town bought two small boats.
